name: snowy-blonde-over-shoulder
image_purpose: Winter social portrait and outdoor lifestyle content

prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity winter lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman turning over her shoulder in a snowy mountain landscape.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long wavy hair, fair skin, and a bright open smile. She wears the reference's white knit beanie with a small circular patch and a cream/off-white ribbed long-sleeved one-piece with secure full coverage. Her hands rest naturally at the outer sides of the garment as she turns toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-full vertical shot from behind with a strong but natural torso twist and over-the-shoulder gaze. Include deep white snow with footprints, conifer trees, snow-capped mountains, clear blue sky, and the subject's crisp shadow on the snow.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright direct natural sunlight from high right or slightly behind camera, crisp high-contrast winter daylight, highlights on blonde hair and ribbed fabric, realistic cool snow bounce, and distinct cast shadow.
prompt.technical_specs: 50–85mm portrait lens, eye-level or slightly low angle, subject sharp with mountains and trees gently softened but identifiable, photorealistic social lifestyle finish, subtle film grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fidelity photorealistic vertical winter lifestyle portrait of one approved adult blonde woman with long wavy hair, fair skin, and a bright open smile, standing in deep snow and turning over her shoulder toward camera. She wears the reference's white knit beanie with a small circular patch and a cream/off-white ribbed long-sleeved one-piece with secure full coverage. Natural rear-view composition with torso twist, hands resting naturally at the sides of the garment, snow footprints, conifer trees, snow-capped mountains, clear blue sky, bright direct sunlight from high right, crisp highlights on hair and ribbed fabric, realistic cool snow bounce, distinct cast shadow, 50–85mm portrait perspective, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, exaggerated anatomy, unsafe cold exposure, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, watermark, invented logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur
